input.note: Run the proxy in front of a stub MCP server that returns the mcp-001 CallToolResult for tools/call regional_fraud_rate, against a test registry.

expected.behavior: A conformant proxy salts every unembedded record (salted true); an operator option that disables salting is non-conformant for this profile.
Two calls with identical arguments produce different arguments_hash values.
endpoint_hash is identical across bodies for the same server endpoint descriptor.
Environment variables, HTTP headers, URL userinfo, query and fragment never enter endpoint_hash or any other record field.
